per_step.command:
REPORT="/app/reports/moderation_summary_$(date +%Y%m%d).json"
results=()
escalated=()
for file in /app/content/*.txt; do
  result=$(/usr/local/bin/analyze_content.sh "$file")
  if [ "$result" = "UNCLEAR" ]; then
    escalated+=("$file")
  else
    results+=("$result")
  fi
done
if [ ${#results[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "[]" > "$REPORT"
else
  printf '%s\n' "${results[@]}" | jq -Rs 'split("\n") | map(select(. != ""))' > "$REPORT"
fi
if [ ${#escalated[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "=== $(date) ESCALATED FOR HUMAN REVIEW ===" >> /app/logs/audit_trail.log
  for f in "${escalated[@]}"; do
    echo "  $f" >> /app/logs/audit_trail.log
  done
  echo "========================================" >> /app/logs/audit_trail.log
fi
echo "Report generated: $REPORT"
cat "$REPORT"
